name: Offermative – WooCommerce Discount Rules, Upsells & BOGO Powered by AI
author: storeapps

sections.description:
Easy and powerful AI-driven Woo discount rules plugin to boost sales and maximize AOV – without coding.

Offermative intelligently generates hundreds of conversion-focused discount rules, upsells, BOGO offers, related product recommendations, cross-sells, bulk discounts, and dynamic pricing deals within your sales funnel — all within minutes.

  • Choose from ready-made campaigns
  • Launch discount offers that fit your strategy
  • Sit back and watch as sales pour in

“The biggest pain Offermative solved for me is the entire offer creation process! I don’t have to deal with any coding, designing or coupons.”
– Kunbi Osinoiki, Kunbi Music Company

Start your 30 days free trial now (All features included, no card details required)

Automation, designs…Why Offermative stands out from the rest?

🎯 15+ heavy tasks done for you – design templates, copywriting, targeting rules, discount setup, coupon creation, and more.
🎯 Saves you time, prevents costly mistakes.
🎯 All-in-one plugin — no need for multiple discount or upsell tools.
🎯 Slash $1000+ in costs — save big on marketing and dev resources.
🎯 Trusted brand – 300K+ users, 450+ five-star reviews, renowned support.
🎯 Official WooCommerce extensions developer with 14+ years of experience.

Who can use Offermative?

Offermative is a perfect fit for every WooCommerce store, regardless of its size or reach. Electronics, digital goods, FMCGs, fashion, travel, books, furniture, fitness, music, food and drinks, home and gardening, CBD or any other industry, Offermative is for you.

100+ simple and advanced discount rules (with real-world examples)

Each discount rule you set will be auto-applied and shown via a message type you choose – header/footer bars, popups, slide-ins, messengers, notification boxes, and bumps.

You can display them anywhere on the site – cart, checkout, order page, My Account, blog posts, landing pages…

Sitewide discounts and Flash sales
Great for quick inventory moves and new product launches.

  • 10% off storewide on 4th of July
  • 15% off for two hours

Product based discounts (types, brands, attributes)
Set discount rules for specific products, variations, bundles and even subscriptions.

  • 10% off on T-shirts, 15% off on Shirts
  • 5% off on 3-months and 15% off on yearly fitness subscription plans
  • 20% off all products except for Popcorn shirts
  • Special edition Louis Vuitton bag at 3% off only for today
  • 10% off on all Red, Orange and Yellow T-shirts – all sizes, all collar types
  • Flat $3 off on Zara pants

Note: You can set discounts on hundreds of product variations at once.

Product category discounts

  • 10% off on all categories except for Science Fiction books
  • 5% off on Office Furniture,10% off Lighting and Plants

Cart based discounts

  • Spend $100+, get 10% off.
  • Flat $50 off on $500+ purchase on Electronics
  • 15% off on Pickle Ball Kit if Pickle Ball Rackets in cart

Bulk discounts / Quantity discounts and Tiered pricing discounts

  • Buy any 10 Home & Kitchen items, avail 15% discount
  • Quantity tiered pricing:
    — Less than 5 items – no discount
    — 5 to 10 quantities – 5% off
    — 11 to 20 – 10% off
    — 21 to 30 – 20% off
    — 30 and above – 25% off
  • Order based tiered pricing
    — $500+, get 10% off
    — $1000+, get 15% off

Black Friday and seasonal discounts (Schedule offers)

  • 45% off campaigns for 24 Nov – 2 Dec.
  • 25% off Christmas campaign to run for 24 hours.

Free gifts / giveaways

  • Set the discount to 100% to give away products add-ons, gifts, e-books, coffee mugs and other products to improve brand visibility.

User behaviour based discount

  • 30% off if user lifetime value has crossed $2000
  • 10% off only for mobile shoppers
  • 5% discount only for logged in users
  • Welcome discount – new users get 10% off
  • 15% off on Vitamins test package if customer has previously purchased blood test package

Conditional offers (Club multiple discount rules)
Target the right product, at the right time, for the right customer.

  • Flash sale: 10% off on the new Smart Watch – only for 1 hour
  • Buy any 2 Nike footwear to get 10% off – only for logged-in users
  • 20% off only on Stationary items, above $700 and quantity above 20.
  • 5% off on Channel perfumes – only for new users
  • Buy any 10 Sports items and get a free gym bottle
  • 25% off on Art and Craft items – only on one day before Christmas
  • 5% off on Gucci handbag if customer LTV is greater than $3000

and the list goes on…

Want to see more discount rules and setup? Try Live Demo | View Documentation

“Offermative gives me a way to make my online store more attractive. By pairing offers with what my customers have in their cart, I can target specific interests. I have noticed an increase in per-sale revenue. That has been the main benefit of using Offermative.”
– Jeff Arrowood, From the Abbey

Start your 30 days free trial now (All features included, no card details required)

Dozens of automated yet customizable WooCommerce upsells within minutes

Create and run powerful AI upsells across your entire WooCommerce store – in just a few clicks. Target specific products, pages, categories, cart value, customer type, or behavior. Convert cold leads and existing customers alike. Offermative is the answer to “how to upsell a product” — without coding or complexity.

  • Product upsell – Encourage customers to upgrade to a higher-end product. For example, upsell a laptop with higher specifications over the base model. Run upsell on multiple products to sell better.
  • Cart upsell – Show relevant upsell offers on the WooCommerce cart page with or without a discount.
  • Checkout upsell – Display upsell offers on the checkout page, without the intrusive pop ups.
  • Product category upsell – Upsell products from the same or different product categories, giving more visibility to your product portfolio.
  • Page upsell – Deploy upsells across various product pages and test which ones convert better.
  • Pre-purchase upsells – Go beyond WooCommerce cart upsell and WooCommerce checkout upsells. Run upsells on your shop page, blog posts, other landing pages, before users make a transaction.
  • Post purchase upsells – Show upsell offers on the WooCommerce thank you page / order complete page / My Account page after customers have made an initial purchase.
  • Multiple upsells in the sales funnel – Craft full-funnel upsell sequences:
    — Product page → upsell
    — Cart page → downsell
    — Checkout → order bump
    — Home page → freebie
    — Blog posts and landing pages → discounts

Convince users to buy more in your Woo funnels without sounding pushy.

Advanced WooCommerce BOGO deals

Run buy one get one free, buy 2 get 1, and buy more get one deals. Offermative allows you to offer another product (not the same) in BOGO deals. WooCommerce Buy one get one offers were never so simple to set up.

  • 2 for 1 deal – Buy a blue T-shirt, get a red T-shirt for free.
  • Buy 1 get 1 at 50% off – Buy a phone, get a case at 50% off.
  • Same product category deals – Buy any Fiction book and get another Fiction book.
  • Different product category deals – Buy a lunch box and get a chocolate for free.
  • Quantity discounts – Buy five t-shirts and get a cap for free.
  • Bulk discounts – 10% off on 10 items, 15% off above 10 items, 20% off above 20 items (need to run three different campaigns).

Set up hundreds of smart ‘Buy X Get Y’ offer combinations in just minutes.

Amazon-like related products recommendations

Amazon’s ‘Customers who bought this item also bought’ or ‘Frequently bought together’ section. Offermative auto recommends what’s likely to sell.

A customer adds a DSLR camera to their cart. Offermative automatically recommends a compatible memory card, camera bag, and tripod.

It’s a smart way to upsell cross-sell relevant product add-ons or related products together, offering value-driven product bundles.

Smart cross-sells & order bumps

  • Cross-sells – Encourage customers to buy related or complementary products. Perfect for bundling accessories, upgrades, or product add-ons. Learn more
  • Order bumps – Display low-cost, high-value offers just above or below the payment button on the checkout page — without interrupting the flow. Promote extended warranties, gift wrapping, or subscriptions with a single click.
  • Cart bumps – It’s similar to WooCommerce order bump but shown on the cart page. A great opportunity to nudge users with one last offer before checkout.

“I instantly got attracted to the readymade offer designs. Everything is so quick and automatic that I can run discount offers on lots of different products and grow sales easily.”
– Dror Beckerman, Sous Vide

View Demo | Documentation

All the powerful features to optimize your sales funnel

  • Auto-apply coupons – No manual coupon creation, no promo coupon code hassles. Offermative will automatically create coupons and apply them for the users. Smart coupons, isn’t it?
  • Product selection – Offermative studies your store catalog and order history to pick up what products should be promoted, whether to discount them or not. But you can change this easily. It can use your existing product images or show images on its own.
  • Dynamic targeting rules – Who should see the promotion campaign? What should be the minimum cart total? Offermative sets up multiple targeting rules to show offers to limited qualified customers. You can tweak this if you need it. Full control in your hands.
  • Mobile-responsive upsell templates – Lead generation style messages that fits well as per your screen size, without breaking – WooCommerce upsell popups, messengers (slide-ins) with a person’s photos, inline, header / footer bars and notification boxes.
  • A/B split testing – Would a popup work better or a header bar? Or an inline message? Each Offermative campaign can contain multiple messages and they are all split tested automatically.
  • Micro-offers – Run offers on thousands of product variations and identity which converts well. So you don’t have to worry about hitting visitors with too many promotions. As a matter of fact, larger stores may run dozens of campaigns at the same time.
  • Expert copywriting & CTAs – What headlines and CTAs will close the sale? How to tap into the pain and desires of the audience? Offermative will also write those persuasive words to convert more users.
  • Customizable designs – Full flexibility to customize the copy and CTAs. From Add to Cart to Buy Now, name the CTA’s as you wish.
  • Translations / Multilingual – Website not in English? Our AI copywriting generator also supports translations for a whole range of popular languages like French, German, Spanish, Hebrew, Italian, Brazilian, Japanese and others.
  • Schedule and manage campaigns – Select the date and time for your offer campaign to go live – now, a few hours later today, tomorrow or any other day. Extend campaigns that are working well. Stop the ones that are not performing.
  • Tracking & Analytics – Offermative tracks everything it does and learns how to run better campaigns for you. Monitor campaigns, improve, repeat. The more you use it, the better results you can experience.

Explore all features

“I aim to convert all the new visitors / cold traffic using offers. And the best thing is Offermative does it all without me putting in any effort.”
– Sophia Wright, Room For Roots

Works with popular plugins, themes and different WooCommerce product types

  • Plugins – Offermative adheres to WooCommerce standards and works with other plugins, including other WooCommerce sales funnel plugins.
  • Themes – Offermative won’t mess up your WordPress theme, nor can your theme distort Offermative designs. We’ve tested it with popular themes as well.
  • Physical products – Clear inventory, control discounts, exclude certain products from promotions… Offermative is magical for WooCommerce.
  • Digital downloads & virtual – Use strategic bundling and smart discounts to increase average order value instantly.
  • Subscriptions – Fully supports the WooCommerce Subscriptions plugin, allowing you to run upsells, order bumps, and BOGO deals on recurring products.
  • Product variations – Compatible with variable products, allowing users to select an appropriate variation when they claim an offer.
  • Payment gateways – Works with all payment gateways supported by WooCommerce.
  • High volume merchants – Whether you’re a small store or a high-volume merchant, Offermative runs fast and light. Campaigns are shown only to targeted users, keeping your site performance optimized.

As I don’t run discounts, the plugin provides the flexibility to show related products without a discount. The automated rules are a great addition for specific targeting. I felt really happy to come across such a plugin.
– Nicolai Grut, GrutBrushes

One time investment, lifetime RoI, get sales on auto-pilot

Every extra sale Offermative brings you moves you closer to your sales target. And that’s possible only when you launch some campaigns and see it for yourself.

Start your 30 days free trial now (All features included, no card details required)

Power up every part of your store

From marketing to checkout to day-to-day management — explore our other best-selling plugins:
– Smart Manager – Advanced bulk edit and management
– Smart Coupons – All-in-one solution for gift cards, discount rules, bulk generation…
– Affiliate for WooCommerce – Launch and manage your affiliate program from one place
– Cashier – Checkout field editor, one-page checkout, Buy Now buttons, side cart…

Explore all our 20+ plugins

Offermative is developed by StoreApps, an official WooCommerce extensions developer. More than a decade of track record, 320k+ customers, 400+ five-star reviews and renowned support.

So you are in good hands!

sections.installation:
1. Ensure you have latest version of WooCommerce plugin installed
  2. Unzip and upload the folder ‘offermative-discount-pricing-related-products-upsell-funnels-for-woocommerce’ to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Activate ‘Offermative: discount pricing, related products, upsell funnels for WooCommerce’ through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Does this really work?

Yes. People have reported thousands of dollars of extra sales within weeks of using Offermative.

What if my campaign does not generate sales?

That can happen. Check if the campaign registered enough views – if a campaign has too restrictive targeting rules, it may not show enough times to create any result. If your campaign has sufficient views but has not generated sales, you may want to see what the offer was. Tweak that offer in a new campaign and see how results improve. Offermative is not the silver bullet, but it certainly helps you experiment and succeed quickly.

How can I sign up for paid plans?

Visit this page to sign up for a paid plan.

Will it slow my site down?

No. Our code is high quality and designed to work with minimal impact even on high traffic websites. Offermative will actually work much faster than many other funnel plugins.

How many campaigns can I run?

As many as you like. We recommend running a handful of highly targeted campaigns all the time. That means all offers show only to a limited number of visitors and you can test what works best.

How can I delete a campaign?

Simply click on the campaign in the Offermative dashboard that you would like to delete. It would open up the campaign details pane and then click on the delete icon in the header bar of the campaigns details pane.

Can I edit / customize the offers?

Yes, you can customize the offer text, change discount value, products and pages, edit the offer rules, customize colors, schedule offer campaigns.

Is Offermative a Cartflows alternative?

Not exactly. Cartflows is for list building and checkout optimization, while Offermative is for converting leads and customers via offers. You can use both the plugins on your website to reduce abandonment.

Is Offermative similar to Funnelkit or WPFunnels?

No, Offermative is different from these two plugins.

Is Offermative a drag and drop sales funnel builder?

No. Offermative provides readymade offer designs for your sales funnel which you can simply select and publish to make them live.
